_readme: 학교별 외국인 유학생 장학금 — 큐레이션 데이터 (선배 라운지와 같은 '손으로 만든 데이터' 계열).
왜 JSON 인가: 장학금은 정부 규정 코퍼스에도, 공공데이터 통계에도 없습니다.
대학마다 자기 홈페이지 공지로만 냅니다. 그래서 RAG 도 SQL 도 답할 수 없고,
'학교별 구조화 데이터' 를 우리가 직접 만들어야 개인화가 성립합니다.
확장 방법: schools 에 항목 하나 추가 = 그 학교 지원 완료 (코드 수정 없음).
⚠️ verify:true 인 금액/비율은 학교 공지 기준 구조이며, 학기마다 바뀝니다.
발표 전 source_url 에서 최신 공지를 확인하고 수치를 갱신하세요.
답변에는 항상 as_of 와 '국제교류처 확인' 안내가 함께 붙습니다.

schools.source_title: University of Seoul · Office of International Affairs — scholarships for international students
schools.context_note: A public (city-funded) university — tuition is already among the lowest in Seoul, so scholarships stack on a low base.

scholarships.benefit: Tuition reduction for new degree entrants, tiered by admission evaluation and Korean proficiency.
Additional tuition reduction for enrolled international students holding TOPIK level 4 or above.
Lab- or department-assigned assistantship: monthly stipend plus tuition support. Applied for through your advisor, not the admissions office.
Awarded each semester on the previous semester's GPA — you become eligible only after one semester of grades.

schools.source_title: Sookmyung Women's University · Office of International Affairs — scholarships for international students
schools.context_note: A private women's university in Seoul — degree admission is for women applicants.

scholarships.benefit: Tuition reduction for new international undergraduates, tiered by Korean proficiency at admission (higher TOPIK level → higher tier).
Continuing tuition reduction for enrolled international students who hold TOPIK level 4 or above.
Awarded each semester on the previous semester's GPA, for students carrying a full course load.
Departmental tuition support for international graduate students, awarded with the admission decision and reviewed each semester.

nationwide.benefit: Full tuition, monthly allowance, airfare and one year of Korean language training — applied for through a Korean embassy or a designated university, not through your department.
nationwide.source_title: Study in Korea · GKS (National Institute for International Education)
